summary: community.general deprecations in 10.1.0: setting ignore_none inside a CmdRunner context (removal in 12.0.0), git_config list_all (use git_config_info, removed in 11.0.0), and git_config state=present without value (use git_config_info to read values).
questions: How should I read a git config value now that git_config list_all is deprecated?
Can I use git_config with state=present and no value?

answer_card.title: git_config read deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `git_config`: `list_all` is deprecated (removed in 11.0.0), and `state=present` without `value` will be disallowed. Use `community.general.git_config_info` to read values.
- `CmdRunner`: setting `ignore_none` inside a runner context is deprecated (removal in 12.0.0).
